---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 💡 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? Is it related to a frustration you experienced?

Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## 🚀 Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
Have you thought of alternative solutions or features? Describe them here.

## 📝 Use Case Examples
Provide examples of how you would use this feature:

**Example 1:**
- User does X
- System does Y
- Result is Z

**Example 2:**
...

## 🎨 Mockups / Examples (Optional)
If applicable, add mockups, screenshots, or links to similar implementations.

## 📊 Priority
How important is this feature to you?
- [ ] Nice to have
- [ ] Would be useful
- [ ] Critical for my workflow

## 🔍 Additional Context
Any other context, screenshots, or information about the feature request.

## ✅ Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing issues/feature requests
- [ ] This feature aligns with the project's goals
- [ ] I am willing to help test this feature
- [ ] I am willing to help implement this feature (optional)
